chief_complaint: Chest discomfort/angina with advanced chronic kidney disease pending kidney transplantation
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 73‑year‑old man with a long history of cardiovascular disease, hypertension, obesity and metabolic syndrome. He underwent coronary artery bypass grafting in October 2011 and continues to require antiplatelet therapy, beta‑blockade and nitroglycerin for angina. Renal function has progressively declined from CKD stage 2 in 2005 to stage 4 by 2011; he is currently listed as awaiting kidney transplantation. Hypertension remains suboptimally controlled on low‑dose amlodipine. He has anemia, proteinuria and is on insulin therapy, indicating overt type 2 diabetes despite the problem list only noting pre‑diabetes. Social isolation and limited contact have been documented since 2012. The most recent encounter was in September 2013, leaving a decade of missing follow‑up data.

active_problems.name: Proteinuria due to type 2 diabetes mellitus
